# AD5X IFS Spoolman v0.6.8-beta

Repair release for native Fluidd integration.

## Fixed
- native Fluidd compatibility assets now use the correct plugin checkout path inside the Z-Mod chroot: `/opt/config/mod_data/plugins/ad5x_ifs_spoolman`;
- automatic UI startup is now fail-closed: a failed native Fluidd repair no longer restores the historical HTML/DOM script injection;
- stale legacy Fluidd injection is actively removed during startup;
- the backend can continue running even if native Fluidd UI repair is temporarily unavailable.

## Compatibility
- Sergey Fluidd: `v1.37.6`
- Native IFS UI patch revision: `10`

This release intentionally does not re-enable the historical injected Fluidd UI as a fallback.
